title: Dang Monsoon Waterfall Circuit, Gira to Girmal

stops.note: The accessible headliner. Do it first, before crowds
Riverside chai halt on the climb to Ahwa
Meadows and cloud; combinable only with an early Girmal start

day_notes.note: Waghai belt then up to Ahwa for the night. Fuel and dinner there; hotels are basic but honest.
Interior forest roads: slow, green, occasionally cloud-blind. Girmal first, Don if time and weather allow, back via Ahwa before dark.

notes: Strictly a July–September plan; the same route in winter is a pleasant forest drive with modest falls. No fuel beyond Ahwa, top up religiously.
